examples.text: — Przyrzeknij mi... przyrzeknij... że spełnisz moją prośbę... — mówiła, z trudnością hamując łzy.
examples.translation: "Promise me... promise... that you will fulfill my request," she was saying, holding back tears with difficulty.
examples.english: "Promise me... promise... that you will fulfill my request," she was saying, holding back tears with difficulty.

examples.text: W umowie z N[iezależnym] S[amorządnym] Z[wiązkiem] Z[awodowym] „Solidarność" Andrzej Duda przyrzekł, że po reelekcji spełni zobowiązania sprzed pięciu lat i wprowadzi emerytury wyłącznie za staż pracy.
examples.translation: In an agreement with the Independent Self-governing Labor Union "Solidarity", Andrzej Duda promised that after reelection he will fulfill his obligation from five years earlier and introduce retirement only according to how long one has worked.
examples.english: In an agreement with the Independent Self-governing Labor Union "Solidarity", Andrzej Duda promised that after reelection he will fulfill his obligation from five years earlier and introduce retirement only according to how long one has worked.

examples.text: Francuski obywatel marokańskiego pochodzenia, Abdeslam przyznał, że przyrzekł wierność Państwu Islamskiemu 48 godzin przed atakami w Paryżu...
examples.translation: Abdeslam, a French citizen of Moroccan descent, admitted that he pledged loyalty to the Islamic State 48 hours before the attacks in Paris...
examples.english: Abdeslam, a French citizen of Moroccan descent, admitted that he pledged loyalty to the Islamic State 48 hours before the attacks in Paris...
